title: Contract Pricing Agreement: Final Rebate Check on an Agreement Terminated Early
content:
## Final rebate check after an early termination — Contract Pricing Agreement

**Rule.** This policy issues the final rebate check on a Contract Pricing Agreement whose status is terminated after the customer's early termination, on a tier whose rebate payout methods include check, when the customer asks for the unpaid rebate to be paid by check. For a final check this policy issues, and only for such a check, the check pays the unpaid rebate balance less the holdbacks this policy sets, the amounts held back stay in the rebate balance, and a check below the tier's minimum rebate payout is not issued; every other payout still pays the rebate balance within the tier's rebate payout period after the period end by the payout method the customer chose from the tier's payout methods, and a balance below the tier's minimum rebate payout still carries forward to the next period instead of being paid.

**When the check can be issued.** On an agreement terminated early, the final rebate check is not issued until the rebate ledger carries the forfeiture entry for the rebate period in which the termination took effect. The final check therefore waits on that forfeiture entry being shown on the rebate ledger.

**What the request does.** The customer's authorized contact instructs Corbett to pay the stated amount of the agreement's unpaid rebate by check. One payout line is recorded on the agreement's rebate ledger against the rebate period named, with check as the payout method, a newly issued check payout reference and the day of the request as the payout date, and the agreement's unpaid rebate balance falls by the amount paid. The customer receives the check payout reference for its records.

### Invocation

This is the customer's own request: the agent unlocks `request_final_rebate_check_d4aa8dfe` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `pricing_agreement_id` | The reference number of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement, as the agent reads it from the agreement lookup and hands it to the customer (id) |
| `rebate_period` | The calendar-quarter rebate period the payout line is recorded against, written YYYY-Qn (four-digit year, a hyphen, the letter Q and the quarter digit 1 to 4), as the agent hands it to the customer |
| `amount` | The amount the check pays, in USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent, as the agent hands it to the customer |

### Return

On success: `status` ("check requested" when the payout line was written), `rebate_line_id` (reference number of the new rebate ledger line), `payout_reference` (the check payout reference issued), `payout_method` (always check), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `rebate_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, the agreement's unpaid rebate balance once the payout is recorded).
